limits: Historical scientific judgments are preserved unchanged; this recovery does not reassess or revise them.

finality_scope: All20 committed/copied file hashes are directly printed in an original projection of the current closure report, which identifies the exact original commit, parent, clean checkout and twenty stable copied links. Its explicit field filter excludes pins while retaining every committed/copied hash row; no whole closure or archive body is reconstructed or claimed. The same original output contains checkpoint fields agreeing with the complete backup entry, the complete postcommit receipt, archive commit/state and final postcommit QA status projection. Actual exact20 commit and nativepostcommit24 are directly observed; that receipt equals the later-read original receipt. Checkpoint/copy/closure and successful terminal executions match the same original progress. Whole closure, archive, final QA and terminal bodies remain unclaimed. Checkpoint/postcommit SHA values are new recovery digests, not separately observed original pins. No historical code executed, timestamp guessed or scientific text rewritten.
